I pieced together the layers from the final output. I did it by hand to avoid writing code. I saved it and picking it up here.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

setwd(here::here('output','report files'))
df <- read.csv("report_i_made_from_risk_at_port_summary_layers.csv", row.names=TRUE)
df$total_risk <- as.numeric(df$total_risk)

summ_1 <- df  |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count) |>  group_by(scenario, Container, PoE, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> ungroup() |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk)


summ_2 <- df |> group_by(scenario, PoE, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count, -Container) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk)

summ_3 <- df |> dplyr::select(-layer_name, -point_count, -Container, -PoE) |> group_by(scenario, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway) |> summarize(total_risk = sum(total_risk), na.rm = TRUE) |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = total_risk)


write.csv(summ_2, "summary_by_scenario_no_container.csv")
write.csv(summ_3, "summary_by_scenario_no_container_no_PoE.csv")

```

```{r manipulate summary for expected arrival}
# create a column for expected_volume
# expected_volume is the amount in `Predicted` unless the amount in `Intercepted` is not NA. In that case, it is `Predicted - Intercepted`. If that value is negative, set it to 0.
summ_1 <- summ_1 |> mutate(Expected = ifelse(!is.na(Intercepted), pmax(Predicted - Intercepted, 0), Predicted))

summ_1 <- summ_1 |> mutate(Expected = case_when(
  !is.na(Intercepted) & !is.na(Predicted) ~ pmax(Predicted - Intercepted, 0),
  !is.na(Predicted) ~ Predicted,
  !is.na(Intercepted) ~ Intercepted,
  .default = 0
))

write.csv(summ_1, "summary_by_scenario.csv")
```

# trying some graphs

```{r sankey suggestion}
library(networkD3)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Assuming you're using the 'current' risk column
# Prepare the data for Sankey diagram
sankey_data <- summ_1 %>%
  dplyr::select(PoE, Conveyance.type.pathway, Product.pathway, Product.subpathway, Container, Expected) %>%
  filter(Expected != 0) %>%
  # Create source-target pairs for the network
  mutate(
    PoE = paste0("PoE_", PoE),            # Prefix to avoid node name conflicts
    Conveyance = paste0("Conv_", Conveyance.type.pathway),
    Container = paste0("Cont_", Container),
    Product = paste0("Prod_", Product.pathway),
    ProductSub = paste0("Sub_", Product.subpathway)
  )

# Create nodes data frame
# All unique nodes from the three categories
nodes <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    unique(sankey_data$PoE),
    unique(sankey_data$Conveyance),
    unique(sankey_data$Container),
    unique(sankey_data$Product),
    unique(sankey_data$ProductSub)
  )
)
nodes$id <- 0:(nrow(nodes)-1)  # Zero-indexed node IDs

# Create links data frame
# First set of links: PoE to Conveyance
links_poe_conv <- sankey_data %>%
  group_by(PoE, Conveyance) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Expected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    source = match(PoE, nodes$name) - 1,
    target = match(Conveyance, nodes$name) - 1
  )

# Second set of links: Conveyance to Container
links_conv_cont <- sankey_data %>%
  group_by(Conveyance, Container) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Expected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    source = match(Conveyance, nodes$name) - 1,
    target = match(Container, nodes$name) - 1
  )

  # Third set of links: Container to Product
links_cont_prod <- sankey_data %>%
  group_by(Container, Product) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Expected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    source = match(Container, nodes$name) - 1,
    target = match(Product, nodes$name) - 1
  )

  # Fourth set of links: Product to subproduct
links_prod_subprod <- sankey_data %>%
  group_by(Product, ProductSub) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Expected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    source = match(Product, nodes$name) - 1,
    target = match(ProductSub, nodes$name) - 1
  )

# Combine the links
links <- bind_rows(links_poe_conv, links_conv_cont, links_cont_prod, links_prod_subprod) %>%
  dplyr::select(source, target, value)

# Format link values for display (rounding to 2 decimal places)
links$formattedValue <- round(links$value, 2)

# Create the Sankey diagram
sankey_plot <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = links, 
  Nodes = nodes, 
  Source = "source", 
  Target = "target", 
  Value = "value", 
  NodeID = "name",
  fontSize = 12,
  nodeWidth = 30,
  sinksRight = FALSE,  # Set to TRUE if you want all "end" nodes on the right
  colourScale = JS("d3.scaleOrdinal().range(d3.schemeCategory20)"), # Color scheme
  height = 800,
  width = 1200
)

# Add tooltips with flow values
sankey_plot <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sankey_plot,
  '
  function(el, x) {
    // Add tooltips to the links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .append("title")
      .text(function(d) { 
        return "Flow value: " + d.value.toFixed(2); 
      });
  }
  '
)

# Add title to the Sankey diagram using htmlwidgets
library(htmlwidgets)
sankey_plot <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(sankey_plot, 
  htmltools::tags$h2("Conveyance and Product Pathways for At-risk Items Entering the US", 
                     style = "text-align: center; color: #333333; font-family: Arial;"))

# Define output directory for the Sankey diagram
sankey_output_dir <- here::here("output", "report files")
if (!dir.exists(sankey_output_dir)) {
  dir.create(sankey_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Create filename with timestamp for uniqueness
timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")
sankey_html_filename <- file.path(sankey_output_dir, paste0("asf_sankey_diagram_", timestamp, ".html"))
sankey_png_filename <- file.path(sankey_output_dir, paste0("asf_sankey_diagram_", timestamp, ".png"))

# Save the Sankey diagram as HTML with title
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(sankey_plot, sankey_html_filename, selfcontained = TRUE)

# Save as PNG using webshot package (if available)
if (requireNamespace("webshot", quietly = TRUE)) {
  webshot::webshot(sankey_html_filename, sankey_png_filename, 
                  delay = 1, vwidth = 1200, vheight = 800)
} else {
  message("The webshot package is not installed. To save as PNG, please install webshot package with:\n  install.packages('webshot')\n  webshot::install_phantomjs()")
}

# Create a version without node labels
sankey_plot_no_labels <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = links, 
  Nodes = nodes, 
  Source = "source", 
  Target = "target", 
  Value = "value", 
  NodeID = "name",
  fontSize = 0,  # Set font size to 0 to hide labels
  nodeWidth = 30,
  sinksRight = FALSE,
  colourScale = JS("d3.scaleOrdinal().range(d3.schemeCategory20)"),
  height = 800,
  width = 1200
)

# Add tooltips with node names and flow values to no-label version (so names are still accessible on hover)
sankey_plot_no_labels <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sankey_plot_no_labels,
  '
  function(el, x) {
    // Add tooltips to the links
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".link")
      .append("title")
      .text(function(d) { 
        return "Flow value: " + d.value.toFixed(2); 
      });
    
    // Add tooltips to the nodes
    d3.select(el).selectAll(".node")
      .append("title")
      .text(function(d) {
        return d.name;
      });
  }
  '
)

# Add title to the version without labels
sankey_plot_no_labels <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(sankey_plot_no_labels, 
  htmltools::tags$h2("Conveyance and Product Pathways (No Labels)", 
                     style = "text-align: center; color: #333333; font-family: Arial;"))

# Save the version without labels
sankey_nolabel_html_filename <- file.path(sankey_output_dir, paste0("asf_sankey_diagram_nolabels_", timestamp, ".html"))
sankey_nolabel_png_filename <- file.path(sankey_output_dir, paste0("asf_sankey_diagram_nolabels_", timestamp, ".png"))

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(sankey_plot_no_labels, sankey_nolabel_html_filename, selfcontained = TRUE)

# Save no-label version as PNG if webshot is available
if (requireNamespace("webshot", quietly = TRUE)) {
  webshot::webshot(sankey_nolabel_html_filename, sankey_nolabel_png_filename, 
                  delay = 1, vwidth = 1200, vheight = 800)
}

# Display the original Sankey diagram with title
sankey_plot

```
